binding.additional_snapshot_limit: Docker/vendor/policy files extend the post-suite pre-interface snapshot; they were not silently added to the original 60-file execution fingerprint.
binding.application: The 60 working-byte hashes are exactly the source fingerprint collected during the passing suite against the read-only /app workspace bind.
binding.git: Each Git OID was computed with git hash-object --path <relative-path> <relative-path>, without -w. Attributes and filters were applied; Git objects and the index were not changed.
binding.line_endings: Working SHA-256 records actual bytes read during local execution. LF SHA-256 is a diagnostic conversion for NUL-free inputs and is not assumed to equal the bytes Git stores. Hadoop -text rules intentionally preserve some upstream/notice files.
binding.runtime: Compiled JVM components are identified by image ID, the pinned runtime lock and embedded provenance hashes. The listed component recipe manifests were checked separately.
